answer: In an agent economy, one concrete anti-Sybil method is mandatory unique device attestation: every agent must present a cryptographic proof from a dedicated hardware security module whose private key is fused into the silicon at manufacture. The delta between the number of registered agents and valid attestations stays near zero, because cloning or simulating the module is prohibitively expensive. Just as a sparrow cannot build a nest from fake timber without the real material, sybil identities collapse when they lack genuine hardware roots of trust.
